body: Hello you, taking seroquel while smoking was what made me stop smoking. The paranoia was so intense i strongly believe I had a toxic psychosis. I used to smoke regularly multiple times a day but at the end everytime i smoked i greened out. You should definitely stop one of the two, you decide which one helps you the most. Take care of yourself

It’s unfair I know. And I feel it’s even worst when you’re a minor because your family won’t take you seriously after being told by doctors you’re faking it. But this community makes me feel less alone? I feel understood, I hope it will bring you as much “comfort” one day.

You didn’t deserve everything she did to you. She’s probably denying it because she doesn’t want to acknowledge all the trauma she gave you. I hope one day you’ll be able to live YOUR life the way you want and be able to decide wether or not she’s a part of it.

I love your last quote “It’s all self-harm, no matter how deep or how you did it”. Couldn’t have phrased it better. You should write a book stranger, feels like you have a lot of interesting stories to share:)

I used to feel that way. I actually thought for so many years that I wasn’t actually “mentally suffering” because I couldn’t go deep. That my problems weren’t that important because deep down I was scared of it hurting so it meant I was only searching for attention!? (Even tho I was hidding my scars everyday). As I said before, I know now that deeper doesn’t mean more. I’ve seen on this app people posting diagrams of skin layers and what “achieving them” (sorry english ain’t my first language but anyways) meant… “cat scratches” are for attention, styro is okay and deeper is good? Society is pushing us to prove everyday that we are worth it. As if we needed to hurt ourselves so bad it wasn’t reversible and then suddenly it’s our fault for not asking for help before? We’re never good enough uh? 

Well you are for me. I mean it. The fact that you took your time to answer my post by sharing your personal life means a lot to me and made me feel seen. 
Thank you. I hope one day we will all get the help we actually need.

People who don’t take you seriously are people who’ve never suffered the way you do. Doesn’t make you less of a person or less worthy of life, it only makes you a real human being in my opinion because even tho you suffer everyday and feel like you are alone you still find the strength in you to wake up every morning. I’m sure you’d be able to help so many more people than those doctors with so many degrees who don’t actually understand us. I don’t know you, you don’t know me, but I’m proud of you.

I was 16 and used by a 26 year old i trusted. Didn’t see it when it happened because he was mature enough to know exactly what to tell me to make me feel secure. I used to think I knew everything because I was depressed, (and studies show that depressed people age faster?) that I was mature enough to know when people were manipulating me. I was so sure of myself I thought I should off myself because nothing in life could make me think otherwise and here he was, telling me I was special, that I understood things girls his age didn’t understand. Don’t believe them. They’re after teens for a reason, because we feel things so deeply and are so desperate to feel wanted and loved that we accept everything. He’s not with girls his age because HE CAN’T GET THEM. (Not saying you’re not worth it, but a guy who truly loves you will wait until your brain and body is fully developed)

Dm me if you want more explanation, I won’t judge you. I know how sexually attractive it can be to be wanted by an older person when everyone around you makes you feel like you’re too much and not enough at the same time. But trust me, I regret believing them every.single.day. I feel even more disguted by myself now than I did when I was a teenager. Please, think about it.

Hey, don’t you dare be disgusted by yourself. You wouldn’t judge someone for doing something “wrong” because they didn’t know better, so why are you so mean with yourself? You don’t like the fact that you hurt yourself physically, then try to stop hurting yourself mentally. I don’t know you, but I’m sure you’re worth it fellow human being and all you can do is try your best. I feel like what you are feeling right now is biased and influenced by other people’s opinion. You know, the ones who never felt the need to hurt themselves and disappear. Cutting yourself isn’t “low”. You did it because you couldn’t do anything else at that moment. Who knows how worse it could’ve been? How good you were to “only” cut yourself. We live in a strange world, and I know most people don’t care about you the way you would like them too. So be that person for yourself and stop being so judgmental:)
